cap: The foreskin and glans carry phimosis, paraphimosis, balanitis and squamous neoplasia, and the shaft skin carries Bowen disease and warts. Inside, the inelastic tunica albuginea around the corpora cavernosa scars in Peyronie disease and ruptures in fracture, and the corpora cavernosa fail to detumesce in priapism. The urethral opening sits ventrally in hypospadias and dorsally in epispadias.
